title: CalculationMatrixColumn - Data API
description: Defines a column in a Decision Matrix. The label for this object is Decision Matrix Column. This object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

ApiName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ApiName.description: The API name of the column.

CalculationMatrixId.description: The ID of the Decision Matrix to which this column belongs. This is a relationship field.

ColumnType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ColumnType.description: Specifies whether the column matches matrix input or is returned as output. Possible values are: Input Output

DataType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
DataType.description: The type of data in the column. Possible values are: Boolean Currency Number NumberRange Percent Text TextRange

DisplaySequence.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DisplaySequence.description: The position of this column in the column order.

IsWildcardColumn.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsWildcardColumn.description: Specifies that this column can contain a wildcard value such as ALL. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

RangeValues.description: A list of values that define range boundaries.

WildcardColumnValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WildcardColumnValue.description: The value that indicates a wildcard, for example ALL. Applicable if IsWildcardColumn is true.

special_access_rules: Access to Decision Matrices requires Omnistudio licenses.
